prompt: A hulking horned beast with coarse charcoal-grey fur, side profile facing west, frozen mid-stride with its head wrenched upward and its eyes flooded blank cerulean white. Glowing cerulean threads of psychic magic descend from above like marionette strings, sinking into the back of its skull, its will broken and pulled toward a new master. The background is a cold dim dungeon hall lit only by the blue glow of the strings.

Two figures, both fully visible. In the foreground a snarling armored ogre warrior, its face going slack and vacant, eyes flaring with cold cerulean light. From behind, tendrils of glowing blue psychic energy coil around the ogre skull and grip its head, dragged backward by an unseen will. The only source of light is the blue psychic energy. The background is a fog-shrouded battlefield at night.

Extreme close-up of a scaled lizardfolk warriors head and shoulders filling the frame, three-quarter view. Its snarling expression is collapsing into blank vacancy as cold cerulean light floods its eyes from within. Glowing blue runic tendrils crawl across its skull and temples, the mind being seized and overwritten. The only source of light is the blue glow on its face. The background is deep shadow.

A massive armored war-elephant beast, side profile facing east, head jerked upward and eyes glowing solid cerulean. A glowing blue psychic hand made of light reaches down from the top of the frame and clamps over the beasts skull, seizing its mind. Faint puppet strings of blue light run from the hand into its head. The background is a cold misty grey battlefield at dusk.

A large grey-green troll warrior stands rigid like a marionette, arms hanging limp, head tilted up, eyes blank glowing cerulean. Taut glowing blue strings run from high above straight down into its skull, wrists and shoulders, suspending its body as a puppet. The will is broken, the body controlled from above. The background is a dim cold blue cavern. The only light is the blue strings.

Two figures both fully visible, same size. On the right a hooded blue-robed mind-mage in side profile, one hand raised and clenched, streams of cold cerulean energy pouring from the hand. On the left a snarling armored brute warrior, head wrenched toward the mage, eyes flooded blank cerulean, falling under control. A taut rope of blue psychic light connects the mages hand to the brutes head. The background is a foggy grey ruin at night.
